CustomField.description: This determines if section grades are graded using % weighted assignment types. Ex: Test = 50% HW = 30% Classwork = 20%
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select if you want SchoolForce to weigh the assignment types using a percentage. For example, you can designate Homework as worth 30% of a student's section grade.
CustomField.label: Use Assignment Type Percentages
